boughkeeper.method: The fixture save's main character is armed with Boughkeeper. UnitCombatState.AttackOfOpportunity queues the game's own UnitAttackOfOpportunity command against a disposable hostile target (a copy of the default player character in the Mobs faction, kept alive) and the test harness runs that command's action while the game is paused. The base attack bonus is raised to 100 for the attack so the hit is certain, and restored. The verdict comes from the game's view objects; the screenshots are for a person to look at. After the tooltip the fight is ended, the target removed and play resumed; the game's automatic pauses are lifted and the buff is given three rounds of game time to end by itself.
boughkeeper.attacks: one attack of opportunity with Boughkeeper: Hit

tooltip.title: Boughkeeper
tooltip.text: +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class until the beginning of the wielder's next turn.
